poetry.title: Hope in the Darkness
poetry.author: Fatima A.
poetry.content:
In the shadows of my room I dream,
Of books and learning, a distant gleam.
Though doors are closed, my mind stays free,
Education lights the path for me.

poetry.title: My Sister's Voice
poetry.author: Zahra M.
poetry.content:
She speaks in whispers through the screen,
Her English words like bridges unseen.
Connecting hearts across the miles,
Bringing knowledge, hope, and smiles.
